content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record leaves material questions open. The Manager's alleged sexual comments (claim 5) are the core of the harassment claim, yet the summary shows no Manager testimony on them. It also shows no interviews of Witness 1, who reportedly apologized for the comments, or Witness 2, who received the report, and none of the Subordinate, who was allegedly questioned about her sex life. The Agency's finding that Complainant first raised concerns on May 14, 2021 conflicts with her report to Witness 2 and is unreconciled. Her claim that the Manager drank without discipline was dismissed as unsupported, with no sign that the Manager or other drinkers were investigated as comparators. Her claim that she lost shared-drive access to evidence was not addressed. Management's claim that no other officers behaved similarly is bare testimony. The decision therefore rests on an incomplete record, not on a fully developed one."}
